description.value:
Hand-ground lens of Yesodium-clouded glass, set in a Tree-of-Life-shard mount.

Recall Sephirah (while attuned, once per scene). Look through the lens at any object, person, or location you have previously perceived under a known sephirotic alignment. Recall that alignment now — the GM names which sefirah dominated the moment.

Memory Edge (while attuned). Once per Battle, Heist or Parley, after a casting check resolves, add +1 to its margin after the fact.

Unattuned: clear glass. Pretty. Inert.

item.signature: What the lens once saw, you see again.
